en: A scrapbook page containing two black‑and‑white postcards with handwritten notes in German and other scripts. The upper postcard shows a panoramic view over a lakeside town with several buildings and forested hills in the background. The lower postcard shows a riverside landscape with bridges and a stone monument or memorial column topped by an eagle. Surrounding the postcards on the album page are handwritten German captions mentioning concert tours in Finland and dates in 1902.
